title: Gerstenhaber algebra structure on the Hochschild cohomology ring of the Xu--Snashall algebra
summary: Let $A$ be a finite dimensional algebra and let $\rmHH^*(A)$ be its Hochschild cohomology ring, which is a Gerstenhaber algebra. Denote by $\calN$ (resp. $G$, $\calG$) the ideal (resp. weak Gerstenhaber ideal, Gerstenhaber ideal) generated by all homogeneous nilpotent elements. Motivated by their work on support varieties via Hochschild cohomology, Snashall and Solberg conjectured that $\rmHH^*(A)/\calN$ is a finitely generated algebra.
